skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand concepts of return and risk, distinguish between actual and required returns.
Understand risk measurement concepts and apply them to individual stocks and portfolios.
Understand cost of capital concepts and calculate costs for debt, equity, and overall capital.
Understand theories of capital structure and determine optimal capital structures.
Understand dividend policies and their implications on company operations.
Manage short-term assets including cash, receivables, and inventory effectively.
Understand M&A processes, benefits, and risks involved.
Apply critical thinking to solve financial management problems.
Work collaboratively in teams to solve financial management issues.
Proactively engage in learning activities and seek solutions independently.
